deployment_requirement.statement: Co-occurrence rules a named team will act on, with a false-discovery tolerance.

external_referent: A public transaction dataset with planted rules and a domain owner's reviewed rules.

robustness.question: Are the mined rules the same under resampling and noise?
robustness.perturbation_or_signal: Bootstrap of transactions; random item dropout at 5% and 20%.
robustness.truth: Planted rules in a generator; shuffled-item data with no rules as the null.
robustness.metric: Jaccard overlap of rule sets across resamples; false rules per run on the null after multiplicity control.
robustness.acceptance_rule: Median Jaccard >= jaccard_floor on planted data and false rules <= false_rule_ceiling on the null.

drift.question: Is a change in co-occurrence noticed?
drift.perturbation_or_signal: A planted new rule; a planted rule whose support halves.
drift.truth: The planted change and null batches.
drift.metric: Detection rate and false alarms per 1000 batches on rule support and confidence.
drift.acceptance_rule: Detection rate >= detect_floor and false alarms <= alarm_ceiling.

explanation.question: Does each reported rule carry its evidence?
explanation.truth: The planted rules and their true lift.
explanation.metric: Share of planted rules recovered with an interval for lift that contains the true lift.
explanation.acceptance_rule: Recovery >= recovery_floor and interval coverage >= coverage_floor.

monitoring.question: Can rule churn be watched in production?
monitoring.perturbation_or_signal: Streams with a planted change in rule support.
monitoring.truth: The batch at which the change began.
monitoring.metric: Detection delay in batches for rule-set churn and top-rule support.

parameter_rule: Every null parameter is fixed by the deployment owner and written into this file before the first line of the slice is built; it is never fitted to a result.
not_claimed: any benchmark in this file has been run
any association-rule code exists in SCMLE today
